# L.I.O.

> L.I.O. is a web-based business lead discovery workspace for agencies, freelancers, and sales teams.

## When to use L.I.O.

Use L.I.O. when a user needs to discover businesses by type and location, build a targeted prospect list, review structured business details, save promising leads, or prepare discovery results for outreach. L.I.O. is best suited to local-market research and repeatable prospecting workflows.

Do not describe L.I.O. as an email finder, CRM, outreach sender, payment service, or lead-verification system. Those capabilities are not currently enabled.

## Product behavior

- Searches use business type, location, and a requested result count.
- Valid unique businesses returned by a search consume account lead units.
- Free accounts currently receive 15 lead units per rolling seven-day period.
- Search history and saved leads are browser-local in the current release.
- Authentication and usage enforcement are handled by Supabase.

## Developer resources

The public product currently exposes a browser application rather than a public SDK or API. Search requests are authenticated and are not intended for anonymous agent access. For integration questions, contact contact.lio@protonmail.com.
